name: Jawad Ali
title: AI Engineer
bio: I'm a results-driven AI/ML Engineer and BS Artificial Intelligence graduate from COMSATS University Islamabad with hands-on experience building production-ready Generative AI systems, LLM applications, and end-to-end automation pipelines. I specialize in designing agentic workflows using LangChain and LangGraph, building RAG pipelines with vector databases, and deploying LLM-powered chatbots via FastAPI and Streamlit. I'm committed to delivering scalable, clean AI architectures that drive measurable business value.

highlights: Designed and deployed autonomous LangChain ReAct agents and LangGraph-based multi-agent systems, automating complex multi-step business workflows across cloud infrastructure.
Implemented and deployed RAG pipelines integrating FAISS and Pinecone vector databases for scalable semantic search and document-based question answering.
Developed production-grade deep learning and classical ML pipelines; integrated trained models into live systems.
Connected and fine-tuned LLMs (OpenAI GPT-4, Claude API, HuggingFace Transformers) to CRMs, databases, and operational services.
Enforced MLOps best practices including MLflow experiment tracking, Docker containerization, and CI/CD pipelines on AWS and Azure.
Engineered prompt engineering strategies and tool/function-calling architectures to improve LLM reasoning and reduce hallucinations.

Built and delivered a handwritten sentence-checking tool for the company using Tesseract OCR for text extraction and OpenAI for reading/comprehension enhancement, in Python — a normal-scope internal project, not a small experiment.
Also handled non-technical responsibilities as an early team member at this startup: managed the company LinkedIn page, posting AI-related news, company updates, and general industry content.
Managed part of the HR process for a period — posting job openings, shortlisting CVs, and moving shortlisted candidates forward in the hiring process.
Worked solo end-to-end on all technical deliverables in this role, from architecture design to deployment.

projects.name: Car Price Analyst Agent
projects.description: My strongest and most complete project: an end-to-end system that scrapes second-hand car listings from Belgian platforms and predicts fair market price via a Streamlit app.
projects.confidence: high — most proud of this, primary project to discuss in interviews
highlights: Built a full data pipeline scraping listings from AutoScout24, GoCars, and 2ehands.
Cleaned and transformed raw scraped data into structured, ML-ready columns.
Trained XGBoost plus two other models for price prediction, reaching ~92% accuracy against a 97% target.
Since the accuracy target wasn't met, shipped a rule-based pricing approach for the MVP, while the trained ML model remains deployed live in parallel as the underlying prediction engine.
Scaled from an initial dataset of 20–30k listings up to 200k+ listings.
Set up a cron job on a remote server that runs the scraper on a schedule, cleans the new data automatically, and stores it in MongoDB — a self-sustaining data pipeline with no manual trigger.
Delivered the user-facing product as a Streamlit app: a user opens the app and checks a vehicle's predicted price on demand (no separate trigger needed for the end user).
Built and worked on entirely solo, from scraping architecture to model training to deployment.

projects.name: Business Analyser Agent
projects.description: An autonomous agent designed to act as a personal business analyst for a company — answering questions about its projects and generating business documents.
highlights: Core goal: build an agent that knows a company's project details and can be queried conversationally about them.
Generates business proposal documents automatically based on project data and context.
Delivered as a Streamlit chatbot application that handles both conversational Q&A and document viewing in one interface.
Built a multi-step autonomous agent using LangChain ReAct with tool-calling, memory management, and intelligent decision routing.
Note: n8n and FastAPI are listed on the CV for this project, but were not actually implemented — the real, deployed core is the LangChain ReAct agent behind a Streamlit interface.
Built solo end-to-end.

projects.name: HEZOP Analyzer Agent
projects.description: A real client/company project: an AI agent that answers process-safety engineering questions using a RAG pipeline over safety documents, working from AutoCAD-derived process diagrams.
highlights: Built for a real client use case (not just a personal exploration project).
AutoCAD P&ID diagrams were exported to DXF format by an external freelancer (this export step was not built in-house).
Converted the received DXF files into structured JSON, and built the downstream analysis and RAG pipeline on top of that JSON representation.
Implemented a RAG-based knowledge pipeline over engineering safety documents so HEZOP engineers can ask natural-language questions and get answers grounded in the safety documentation.
Primary value delivered: precise, document-grounded answers to engineer questions, rather than automated hazard-detection from the diagram itself.
Built solo end-to-end on the parts owned in-house (DXF-to-JSON pipeline, RAG system, and Q&A interface).

projects.name: SmartInfo — YouTube & Document Content Analyzer
projects.description: Final Year Project (academic): a RAG-powered content analyzer for YouTube transcripts and documents.
projects.confidence: lowest — least confident discussing this one in depth
highlights: Academic Final Year Project only — never had real users or production deployment.
Designed an end-to-end RAG pipeline with FAISS vector search and LangChain agent tools for intelligent Q&A over YouTube transcripts and documents.
Fine-tuned HuggingFace transformer models; integrated a React.js frontend with a FastAPI backend.
No formal evaluation metric was used to measure answer quality — improvements were judged through manual/human checking rather than a quantitative benchmark.
Built solo as an individual academic project.

projects.name: Job Portal Web App
projects.description: A full-stack MERN job posting web application with authentication and job CRUD functionality.
highlights: Built full user authentication: registration, login, JWT token-based sessions, bcrypt password hashing with salt.
Implemented protected routes and middleware-based JWT verification for secured API endpoints.
Built job management features: post, view, edit, and delete job listings, with jobs linked to user profiles via Mongoose relationships (postedBy references User).
Designed REST API with endpoints for auth (register/login/me) and jobs (CRUD + get-my-jobs).
Built the full React frontend: registration/login forms, job listing/browsing, 'My Jobs' management view, and navigation — using React Router and hooks-based state management.
Built solo end-to-end, both backend and frontend.

projects.name: HerMoney Landing Page
projects.description: A conversion-focused marketing landing page for a financial education and media brand supporting women in building money confidence.
highlights: Built a single-page app blending lifestyle-brand aesthetics with practical financial education content, designed for trust and conversion rather than technical finance language.
Implemented a multi-language toggle (NL / EN / TR / FR) sharing page logic across languages.
Structured the page into conversion-focused sections: Hero, Problem, Solution, Social Proof, Programs, Quick Tips, How It Works, Community, Final CTA, and Footer with newsletter signup.
Designed a card-based UI with a soft lavender/beige palette, scroll-triggered reveal animations, and a fully mobile-responsive layout.
Deployed on Vercel using Vite's build pipeline.
Built solo end-to-end, including design direction and copywriting intent.

projects.name: Personal Portfolio Website
highlights: Built and deployed my personal portfolio showcasing my projects, skills, and background.
Built solo end-to-end.

projects.name: Handwritten Sentence Checker
projects.description: A company project (built while at OptimAIze BE) that reads and checks handwritten sentences using OCR combined with LLM-based reading enhancement.
highlights: Used Tesseract OCR to extract text from handwritten input.
Used OpenAI's API to enhance and correct the raw OCR reading, improving accuracy on messy handwriting.
A normal-scope internal company project — not a quick experiment, but also not a large-scale production system.

projects.name: Computer Vision & ML Practice Projects
projects.description: A set of personal learning/practice projects covering classic computer vision and ML problems, unpaid and for skill-building rather than client delivery.
projects.confidence: medium — practice projects, good for demonstrating fundamentals
highlights: Handwritten Digit Classification — trained a classifier (CNN-based) on handwritten digit image data.
Garbage Detection & Classification — a computer vision project to detect and classify garbage/waste types from images.
Stock Price Prediction — a time-series ML project predicting stock price movement/trends.
These were personal practice projects to build foundational ML/CV skills, not paid or client-facing work.

projects.name: Freelance: n8n Automation Projects
projects.description: Freelance automation workflows built in n8n for clients, integrating APIs, LLMs, and messaging/notification systems.
highlights: Apify Listings Processing & Alert Automation — built an n8n workflow that fetches listing data from an Apify dataset via HTTP request, sends each listing to OpenAI for scoring against predefined prompts, filters by score, stores approved listings in Google Sheets (with duplicate prevention), and sends formatted alerts to Telegram automatically.

Amazon Wine Recommendation Automation — built an n8n workflow that searches Amazon.it for wine products based on a user's text request and budget, retrieves product data via an external scraping/API service, verifies availability, filters down to exactly two suitable recommendations, generates clean ASIN-format product links, and returns the result as structured JSON via webhook.

projects.name: Freelance: Vehicle Departure Prediction (Power BI)
projects.description: A paid freelance analytics project predicting which drivers are likely to be late vs on-time for departures, delivered with a Power BI dashboard and written report.
projects.confidence: medium — some details forgotten, documentation wasn't kept at the time
highlights: Built a predictive analysis identifying which drivers were likely to be late vs on-time for departures.
Delivered a Power BI dashboard visualizing the analysis for the client.
Produced a 5-page written report summarizing findings and predictions as the final client deliverable.
Paid freelance client work.
Note: some finer details of this project were not documented at the time and aren't fully recalled — going forward, documentation is a top priority for all new projects.

projects.name: Vehicle Insurance Prediction — MLOps Pipeline
projects.description: A learning project built by following an MLOps tutorial to practice the full ML lifecycle, not an original production system.
projects.confidence: low — built primarily as a guided learning exercise, not confident going deep on internals
highlights: Followed a YouTube tutorial to learn end-to-end MLOps practices (data ingestion, validation, transformation, training, evaluation, deployment).
Implemented MLflow Model Registry, Docker containerization, and AWS S3 for artifact storage as part of the guided pipeline.
Primary purpose was hands-on MLOps learning rather than solving an original business problem — best framed in interviews as 'a structured pipeline I built to learn production MLOps practices.'

faqs.question: Are you open to remote work?
faqs.answer: Yes, I'm open to remote work. I'm currently working remotely with OptimAIze BE in Belgium, and I'm comfortable collaborating across time zones.

faqs.question: What's your strongest area?
faqs.answer: My strongest area is building production-ready Generative AI systems — especially agentic workflows with LangChain/LangGraph, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations (OpenAI, Claude), and end-to-end pipelines that go from data scraping to a deployed model.

faqs.question: Which project are you most confident discussing in depth?
faqs.answer: The Car Price Analyst Agent — I built the entire pipeline solo, from web scraping across multiple sites, to data cleaning at 200k+ record scale, to model training and comparison, to a scheduled cron-based scraping system on a remote server, to the final Streamlit product.

faqs.question: Do you always work in a team?
faqs.answer: No — I've built all of my listed projects solo, end-to-end, including my current work at OptimAIze BE.
